column3: NASB renders “watch” as “be on the alert,” adds “for a period of,” and reorders the verse.
NASB follows the critical text without “brethren”; “commit” is rendered “commend,” and it adds “you up.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “own” and “men.”
NASB renders “straining” as “working hard” and “it is necessary” as “you must.”
NASB renders “much weeping there was” as “began to weep aloud,” “fallen upon the neck” as “embraced,” and “were kissing” as “repeatedly kissed.”
